The console is tightly wrapped in clear plastic film.
A blue camouflage DualShock 4 wireless controller is present.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on all images.
The PlayStation 'PS' logo is visible on the top left corner of the console in photos 0, 1, and 2.

no photos show game discs or a digital library on a screen.
PES 2027 does not exist; the Pro Evolution Soccer series was discontinued and rebranded to eFootball in 2021.
